scope: arbitrary total Boolean functions on n hidden individually queryable bits, all transcripts

paid.valid_constraint: FOR ALL n-bit Boolean f, hidden x, transcript and unknown-coordinate read: lambda_B+n*lambda_W+lambda_D<=1, lambda >= 0 is necessary and sufficient across all f; necessity OR_n positive bit

exact_certificates.universal_three_component: lambda_B + n*lambda_W + lambda_D <= 1 (all n-bit f), nonnegative exact rational weights

note: Global cone over ALL n-bit Boolean functions, not a single chosen f. For a fixed f a wider cone may exist. No general SAT-machine transfer. Source-fixed D_x is an offline potential, not online advice.
